messages:
Arun: FYI nightly smoke on h100 fleet just turned red — warmup OOM + 'invalid device function' after driver bump to 535.60. Seen it locally?
ci-bot: [automated] nightly-smoke #1245 failed on h100-az1 (exit 137). logs: https://ci/internal/1245
Sasha: ugh. which image + kernel? any recent cudatoolkit changes?
Arun: image: inference-canary:2026-03-17, kernel 6.1.0-rt, cudatoolkit 12.2 pinned. noise in dmesg: `NVRM: Xid 31` then a few `invalid device function` lines. small log snippet: ```
E/CUDA: invalid device function at src/attention.cu:432
E/ALLOC: alloc failed during warmup, requested 1.2GB
```
Mike: can you paste top of `nvidia-smi -q` and driver version from the node?
Arun: driver reported 535.60.0 by `nvidia-smi`. Attached output to the CI artifact.
laura: quick check — does rerun on a node with the previous driver (535.54) repro? that would tell us regression vs image.
Sasha: +1. if it only fails on 535.60, we should bisect driver pull. If it fails on 535.54 too then suspect image/kernel or our kernels.
Arun: kicking a targeted rerun now with driver pinned to 535.54 on h100-az3. Command I used: ```./ci/scripts/rerun-smoke --node h100-az3 --image inference-canary:2026-03-17 --env DRIVER_VERSION=535.54 --keep-artifacts```
ci-bot: [manual trigger] rerun requested by Arun (job 1245-rerun-1).
Mike: while that runs, can someone grep the build for PTX-specific flags? earlier we saw JIT differences when PTX checksum changed after a toolchain bump.
Sasha: checking build logs... found `--ptx-ascii` not set, but kernel compile flags look unchanged. attaching snippet.
Arun: rerun started. ETA ~8m. if it passes on 535.54 we'll open driver bisect ticket. If it still fails, next step is a bisect across our PRs (quant/kernels).
ci-bot: job 1245-rerun-1: warmup passed on replicas 0..2, failed on replica 3 with OOM at 00:07:12. full logs: https://ci/internal/1245/rerun-1/logs
laura: looks like nondeterministic replica failure, could be memory fragmentation. try lowering concurrency and enabling KVCACHE fix patch from my branch?
Arun: good call. I'll queue another rerun with CONCURRENCY=1 and laura/kvcache-fix applied. Command: ```./ci/scripts/rerun-smoke --node h100-az4 --env CONCURRENCY=1 --patch refs/heads/laura/kvcache-fix```
Sasha: if that repros consistently, please create a bisect ticket and assign infra to hold off driver rollout until we have a mitigator.
Arun: will do. opening ticket INFRA-3987 if second rerun fails. will post updates here. :thumbsup:
